In front of the neck there is a gray tube with ring-like segments that goes downward into the thoracic cavity and continues to branch into the lungs; the arrow of the letter E on the right points to this airway from the neck to the chest. Reasoning: The question asks which labeled part is also called wind pipe. wind pipe is the common name of trachea, and E in the image points to the trachea. Therefore the answer is E.
